sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 上期《每日》节目回顾。

sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: My colleague Lindsay
sentences.zh: 我的同事琳赛

sentences.en: Garrison told the story of N, a teenager in Afghanistan whose family was trying to force her to marry a member of the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 加里森讲述了 N 的故事，她是一名阿富汗少女，她的家人企图强迫她嫁给一名塔利班成员。

sentences.en: They want to give me to a Taliban in case they think if I got married with a Taliban, then the Taliban will not kill her.
sentences.zh: 他们想把我送给一个塔利班，因为他们觉得如果我嫁给一个塔利班，那么塔利班就不会杀她。

sentences.en: You know, there will not be a danger for us.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们就不会有危险了。

sentences.en: But I can't.
sentences.zh: 但我做不到。

sentences.en: She resisted.
sentences.zh: 她进行了反抗。

sentences.en: And now every day they're beating me.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们每天都在殴打我。

sentences.en: At first, my father beat me and then my brother.
sentences.zh: 一开始是我父亲打我，然后是我哥哥。

sentences.en: And they abused her, which led her to attempt suicide.
sentences.zh: 他们虐待她，导致她企图自杀。

sentences.en: And I told him, my father and everyone, don't beat me.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，我父亲还有所有人，别打我。

sentences.en: I will do it.
sentences.zh: 我会做的。

sentences.en: You know, you don't kill me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你们不用杀我。

sentences.en: I will kill my own self.
sentences.zh: 我会自己了结。

sentences.en: You'd rather die than, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你宁愿死也不愿，对吧。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: The only person who is with me and home is my mother.
sentences.zh: 家里唯一陪着我的人是我妈妈。

sentences.en: My mother, she's always saying that I know this is wrong, but I can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈，她总是说我知道这是错的，但我无能为力。

sentences.en: She escaped.
sentences.zh: 她逃走了。

sentences.en: After that, I decided that I want to leave this home.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我决定我要离开这个家。

sentences.en: I want to leave home.
sentences.zh: 我想离开家。

sentences.en: I want to tell you about more things.
sentences.zh: 我想跟你多聊聊一些事情。

sentences.en: So if you have time, then you can call me.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有时间的话，可以给我打电话。

sentences.en: I want to share something with you.
sentences.zh: 我想跟你分享一些东西。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: You know, something happened to my family.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我家里发生了一些事。

sentences.en: The attack to my family.
sentences.zh: 对我们家的袭击。

sentences.en: I could not sleep all night because my family was in danger.
sentences.zh: 我整晚都睡不着，因为我的家人处于危险之中。

sentences.en: And, and, and, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且，而且，而且，你知道的。

sentences.en: What happened to Anne after she fled her family's home?
sentences.zh: 安在逃离家门后发生了什么？

sentences.en: The world must know the real face of these bloody pupils, these bloody talibans.
sentences.zh: 全世界都必须认清这些血腥之徒、这些血腥塔利班的真实面目。

sentences.en: I'm very angry.
sentences.zh: 我非常生气。

sentences.en: And I want to tell the old story for you.
sentences.zh: 我想把整个故事告诉你。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 12 月 20 日，星期一。

sentences.en: After Anne left her home in the fall, we kept talking on the phone and exchanging voice memos.
sentences.zh: 秋天安离开家后，我们继续通过电话交谈并交换语音备忘录。

sentences.en: Almost every day.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天都在交流。

sentences.en: She told me a volunteer aid worker who had been helping Afghans in need helped get Anne to a safe location somewhere in Afghanistan for the time being.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，一位曾帮助过有需要阿富汗人的志愿者救援人员，暂时把安送到了阿富汗某处安全的地方。

sentences.en: Anne was hoping she would eventually evacuate the country.
sentences.zh: 安希望自己最终能撤离这个国家。

sentences.en: And while she was waiting, she told me something terrifying happened.
sentences.zh: 在她等待的时候，她告诉我发生了一件可怕的事。

sentences.en: One of my friends, she was our neighbor.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友，她是我们的邻居。

sentences.en: And I was messaging actually with her.
sentences.zh: 其实我当时正跟她发信息。

sentences.en: And a message comes to my phone.
sentences.zh: 我的手机收到了一条消息。

sentences.en: She wrote to me that some men that have guns come to your home.
sentences.zh: 她写信告诉我，有一些带枪的男人去了你家。

sentences.en: And I think your family situation is not good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们家的情况不太妙。

sentences.en: It was exactly Anne's greatest fear.
sentences.zh: 这正是安最恐惧的事。

sentences.en: My hand was shaking.
sentences.zh: 我的手在发抖。

sentences.en: That because she had left, now her family would be targeted by the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 因为她离开了，现在她的家人会成为塔利班的目标。

sentences.en: I was not good.
sentences.zh: 我当时感觉很不好。

sentences.en: I was not feeling good.
sentences.zh: 我感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: And her mind started racing.
sentences.zh: 她的脑子开始飞速运转。

sentences.en: I was just praying for them.
sentences.zh: 我只能为他们祈祷。

sentences.en: And I was praying for them that
sentences.zh: 我为他们祈祷，希望

sentences.en: Allah helped them.
sentences.zh: 真主能帮助他们。

sentences.en: She told me she felt like this was all her fault.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她觉得这一切都是她的错。

sentences.en: I was thinking that I'm so selfish.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得自己太自私了。

sentences.en: I left my family alone.
sentences.zh: 我把家人留下了。

sentences.en: And I left them in danger.
sentences.zh: 我把他们置于危险之中。

sentences.en: I was thinking like that.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这么想的。

sentences.en: Anne was desperate to know exactly what had happened.
sentences.zh: 安迫切想知道到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: But she didn't want to call her family herself.
sentences.zh: 但她自己不想给家里打电话。

sentences.en: She had just left home and didn't want her family to have her number or any way to access her.
sentences.zh: 她刚离开家，不想让家人有她的号码或任何能联系到她的途径。

sentences.en: So she asked her best friend to call her mom instead.
sentences.zh: 于是她请求最好的朋友给她妈妈打电话。

sentences.en: And this is what she said she learned from that phone call.
sentences.zh: 这就是她所说的从那通电话中了解到的情况。

sentences.en: My father, he engaged me.
sentences.zh: 我父亲，他给我订了婚。

sentences.en: I don't know with who, but he engaged me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道跟谁，但他把我订出去了。

sentences.en: It turned out that just before Anne had left home, Anne's father and brothers had lined up a second Taleb for Anne to marry.
sentences.zh: 原来就在安离家前不久，安的父亲和哥哥们已经为安物色了第二个要嫁的塔利班成员。

sentences.en: And the plan was for the engagement to become official at the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 计划在周末正式订婚。

sentences.en: They decided to come to our home on Friday for my engagement.
sentences.zh: 他们决定周五来我家商量订婚的事。

sentences.en: And my father was, he promised to him, now I'll give you my daughter, like a promise for them.
sentences.zh: 我父亲向他承诺过，现在我会把女儿嫁给你，就像给他们的一个承诺一样。

sentences.en: So when Anne disappeared just a couple of days before, it shattered the whole arrangement.
sentences.zh: 所以当安在几天前突然失踪时，整个安排都被打碎了。

sentences.en: When my father saw that my daughter is not at home, then what should I do with those people who I promised to do?
sentences.zh: 当父亲发现女儿不在家时，心想我该怎么对那些我许诺过的人交代？

sentences.en: I promised to them that I will give you my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我向他们承诺过我会把女儿嫁给你们。

sentences.en: So what will I do with them?
sentences.zh: 那我该怎么面对他们？

sentences.en: Suddenly, Anne's father had to figure out what he was going to do.
sentences.zh: 突然间，安的父亲不得不去想该怎么收场。

sentences.en: He decided to call those people that I want to cut this promise.
sentences.zh: 他决定给那些人打电话说我想要取消这个承诺。

sentences.en: I will not give you my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我不会把女儿嫁给你们。

sentences.en: And when he told to them, they told that she is my wife, like she's my fiance, like this.
sentences.zh: 当他告诉他们时，对方却说她已经是我的妻子了，就像她是我的未婚妻一样，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Anne said that apparently the Taleb's family was pretty furious.
sentences.zh: 安说，显然那个塔利班的家人非常愤怒。

sentences.en: It was a huge embarrassment because they had already kind of told people.
sentences.zh: 这让人觉得颜面尽失，因为他们其实已经跟别人说过了。

sentences.en: It's a big deal for an Afghan to tell to everyone that this girl is my fiance.
sentences.zh: 对阿富汗人来说，告诉所有人这个女孩是我的未婚妻是件大事。

sentences.en: They told that thing for their whole family.
sentences.zh: 他们把这件事告诉了整个家族。

sentences.en: And they did not accept it.
sentences.zh: 他们无法接受。

sentences.en: After that, you know, they told that, oh, just bring your daughter to us.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，你懂的，他们说，哦，那就把你们女儿带到我们这来。

sentences.en: Instead, they made a threat.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们发出了威胁。

sentences.en: If you didn't bring her, then I will kill your family like this, like a black male.
sentences.zh: 如果不把她带来，我就杀你全家，就像这样，纯粹是勒索。

sentences.en: I'm not in there and I don't know the real story, but it was like that.
sentences.zh: 我不在那里，也不知道真实的故事，但情况大致就是这样。

sentences.en: According to Anne's mom, it was just after this, on the night that Anne was texting with her friend, when all of a sudden, the lights went out in her family's house.
sentences.zh: 据安的妈妈说，正是在这之后，也就是安和朋友发短信的那天晚上，家里突然停电了。

sentences.en: Our home's electricity was cutted.
sentences.zh: 我们家的电被切断了。

sentences.en: It was totally dark and Anne's mom peered out the window to see if maybe there was a power outage in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 四周一片漆黑，安的妈妈向窗外张望，想看看是不是社区停电了。

sentences.en: And she was like, what happened with electricity?
sentences.zh: 她当时想，电怎么回事？

sentences.en: She was thinking like that.
sentences.zh: 她心里这么琢磨着。

sentences.en: But she saw out of window, every home have electricity, but our home's electricity was cutted.
sentences.zh: 但她朝窗外一看，家家户户都有电，只有我们家的电被断了。

sentences.en: Everyone else's lights were still on.
sentences.zh: 其他所有人的灯都还亮着。

sentences.en: And that's when Anne's mom's heart froze.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，安的妈妈心头一紧。

sentences.en: She saw that some men are coming from the walls to the room.
sentences.zh: 她看到有些男人正顺着院墙翻进房间里。

sentences.en: She saw in the shadows, six men with rope and guns.
sentences.zh: 她在阴影中看到了六个拿着绳子和枪的男人。

sentences.en: Guns, a rope.
sentences.zh: 有枪，还有绳子。

sentences.en: Climbing over the wall of their courtyard.
sentences.zh: 正翻过他们家的庭院墙壁。

sentences.en: They were climbing the walls to come at home.
sentences.zh: 他们正翻墙进屋。

sentences.en: The family started panicking.
sentences.zh: 一家人开始惊慌失措。

sentences.en: They started yelling.
sentences.zh: 他们开始大声尖叫。

sentences.en: And everyone was loudly.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在大喊大叫。

sentences.en: They want help.
sentences.zh: 他们想寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And they just tried to make a noise that neighbors come to help them.
sentences.zh: 他们拼命制造动静，好让邻居来帮他们。

sentences.en: And my small brother, he acts like he has a gun.
sentences.zh: 我小弟弟装得好像他有枪一样。

sentences.en: And he's trying to shoot the man.
sentences.zh: 他试图向那个人开枪。

sentences.en: And Anne's little brother started talking loudly about shooting one of them.
sentences.zh: 安的小弟弟开始大声嚷嚷着要向其中一人开枪。

sentences.en: Come on, I won't shoot that one.
sentences.zh: 来吧，我要打死那个。

sentences.en: You know, there was no gun with him, but he acts like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他身上根本没有枪，但他就是在装腔作势。

sentences.en: And eventually, the neighbors come out.
sentences.zh: 最后，邻居们出来了。

sentences.en: The family made enough noise that some of the neighbors did come out to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 家人制造了足够的动静，一些邻居确实出来查看发生了什么。

sentences.en: And that's when.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候。

sentences.en: They just gone.
sentences.zh: 他们突然走了。

sentences.en: They were searching my family.
sentences.zh: 他们在搜查我的家人。

sentences.en: They were searching us.
sentences.zh: 他们在搜查我们。

sentences.en: And they told that we will take that girl from you.
sentences.zh: 他们放话要从我们这把那个女孩带走。

sentences.en: I decided that if my family is in danger because of me, then I will go and I will marry to a Talib.
sentences.zh: 我决定，如果我的家人因为我而处于危险之中，那么我就去嫁给一个塔利班。

sentences.en: So you were prepared to change your mind?
sentences.zh: 所以你当时准备改变主意了？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If my family is in danger because of me, and if the danger can be solved by marrying with a Talib, then I will do that thing.
sentences.zh: 如果我的家人因为我而陷入危险，如果这种危险可以通过嫁给一个塔利班来解决，那我就会这么做。

sentences.en: At first, she thought about just going back home.
sentences.zh: 起初，她只是想着回家算了。

sentences.en: But then she remembered the aid worker and how she got Anne to a safe place.
sentences.zh: 但随后她想起了那个救援人员，以及她是如何把安送到安全地方的。

sentences.en: And Anne wondered if maybe the aid worker could do the same for Anne's family.
sentences.zh: 安在想，也许这位救援人员也能为安的家人做同样的事。

sentences.en: She didn't want to be with them.
sentences.zh: 她不想跟他们在一起。

sentences.en: But if they could at least be safe, that would give her some peace of mind.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们至少能确保安全，那也能让她安心一些。

sentences.en: So Anne brought this idea to the aid worker.
sentences.zh: 于是安把这个想法告诉了救援人员。

sentences.en: And the aid worker said she would try.
sentences.zh: 救援人员说她会尽力尝试。

sentences.en: And so then Anne was in the state of waiting.
sentences.zh: 然后安就陷入了漫长的等待状态。

sentences.en: Anne, how are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 安，你今天过得怎么样？

sentences.en: We continued talking just about every single day.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎每天都在继续聊天。

sentences.en: I'm fine.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: Are you fine?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: Exchanging voice memos, calling each other, texting each other.
sentences.zh: 互发语音备忘录，通电话，发短信。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Sometimes just passing the time.
sentences.zh: 有时纯粹是为了打发时间。

sentences.en: Can I ask what's your dog's name?
sentences.zh: 我能问问你的狗叫什么名字吗？

sentences.en: And being in that state of limbo was sometimes hard for Anne.
sentences.zh: 处于这种动荡不安的状态对安妮来说有时很难熬。

sentences.en: I haven't sleep all the nights.
sentences.zh: 我已经好几晚没睡了。

sentences.en: Sometimes she'd send me a voice memo in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 有时她会在半夜给我发语音消息。

sentences.en: Exactly now.
sentences.zh: 就是现在。

sentences.en: I wake up from my sleep because I saw her cream.
sentences.zh: 我从睡梦中醒来，因为我听到她在尖叫。

sentences.en: Some days were just really hard.
sentences.zh: 有些日子真的很难熬。

sentences.en: I'm not good.
sentences.zh: 我状态不好。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不好。

sentences.en: Hey, Anne, just checking on you today.
sentences.zh: 嘿，安妮，今天来看看你过得怎么样。

sentences.en: Just wanted to see how you're feeling, if your headache is any better, if you're feeling any better, and just check on you.
sentences.zh: 只是想看看你感觉如何，头痛有没有好点，有没有感觉好一点，顺便来看看你。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: I wish you're fine.
sentences.zh: 我希望你一切都好。

sentences.en: And thank you so much that you're asking.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的关心。

sentences.en: But then she also had these days where she was happier.
sentences.zh: 但随后她也有一些日子过得比较开心。

sentences.en: Where she seemed to kind of find herself again.
sentences.zh: 在那些日子里，她似乎找回了自我。

sentences.en: Positive energy and some positive power.
sentences.zh: 积极的能量和一些正面的力量。

sentences.en: Her voice was lighter, stronger, louder.
sentences.zh: 她的声音变得更轻快、更坚定、更洪亮了。

sentences.en: Today I feel good because, you know, I went to help some families.
sentences.zh: 今天我感觉很好，因为，你知道的，我去帮助了一些家庭。

sentences.en: She started working with the aid worker.
sentences.zh: 她开始与救援人员合作。

sentences.en: Helping other people, often women, who are in need of basic necessities, like shelter, food, money.
sentences.zh: 帮助其他人，通常是那些急需基本生活必需品的女性，比如住所、食物、金钱。

sentences.en: I was really happy today, and I am, because I save a family.

sentences.zh: 但一位发言人告诉我，他们正在优先撤离美国

sentences.en: citizens and Afghans who have worked with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 公民以及曾与美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府合作过的阿富汗人。

sentences.en: The spokesperson also informed me that there have been challenges with some privately organized flights trying to evacuate Afghans who haven't been cleared or aren't eligible to come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这位发言人还告诉我，一些私人组织的航班在试图撤离那些未经批准或不符合来美资格的阿富汗人时遇到了一些挑战。

sentences.en: But they wouldn't comment on whether Anne fit that situation.
sentences.zh: 但他们拒绝评论安是否属于这种情况。

sentences.en: So when Anne got this news, she immediately worried about the future.
sentences.zh: 所以当安听到这个消息时，她立刻开始为未来担忧。

sentences.en: If she couldn't leave the country, there weren't that many options for her.
sentences.zh: 如果她无法离开这个国家，她并没有太多选择。

sentences.en: In Afghanistan, to be alone is too hard.
sentences.zh: 在阿富汗，孤身一人太难了。

sentences.en: Like, no one allows someone to leave alone.
sentences.zh: 没人允许任何人独自离开。

sentences.en: Or, you know, a girl.
sentences.zh: 特别是，你知道，一个女孩。

sentences.en: And I was just thinking that I'm not educated.
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，我没有受过教育。

sentences.en: I haven't went to college.
sentences.zh: 我没有上过大学。

sentences.en: Or I can't do a job.
sentences.zh: 或者我无法找到工作。

sentences.en: And what should I do now?
sentences.zh: 那我现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: And without seeing a future.
sentences.zh: 而且看不到未来。

sentences.en: Anne could only see the paSt.
sentences.zh: 安只能看到过去。

sentences.en: And that happy moment that she had just shared with her family faded as she thought about what life was actually like with them.
sentences.zh: 当她想到和家人在一起的真实生活时，她刚刚和家人分享的那个快乐时刻便消逝了。

sentences.en: In a Taliban-controlled Afghanistan, she knew what they were capable of if their lives were threatened again.
sentences.zh: 在塔利班控制下的阿富汗，她深知如果他们的生活再次受到威胁，这些人会做出什么事。

sentences.en: If I went back to my family, I don't know what would happen.
sentences.zh: 如果我回到家人身边，我不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: I just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我就是不知道。

sentences.en: How should I face them?
sentences.zh: 我该如何面对他们？

sentences.en: And what would they do?
sentences.zh: 他们会做什么？

sentences.en: Like, they will beat me again for no reason.
sentences.zh: 他们会无缘无故地再次殴打我。

sentences.en: But as she continued talking, her fears eventually turned into something else.
sentences.zh: 但随着她继续诉说，她的恐惧最终变成了另一种情绪。

sentences.en: I was telling to myself that how stupid was I, that I, you know, I think that, okay, my life changed.
sentences.zh: 我当时在对自己说，我怎么这么蠢，竟然会觉得，好吧，我的生活改变了。

sentences.en: Anger at herself.
sentences.zh: 对自己的愤怒。

sentences.en: I was blaming myself.
sentences.zh: 我在责备自己。

sentences.en: Why you saw those dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 你为什么会做那些梦。

sentences.en: Why you saw dreams about your future.
sentences.zh: 你为什么会做关于未来的梦。

sentences.en: Like, why I, you know, I grew hope inside of me.
sentences.zh: 为什么我会，你知道，我在自己心里燃起了希望。

sentences.en: Why I have done all those things.
sentences.zh: 为什么我要做所有这些事。

sentences.en: You're angry at yourself for having some hope.
sentences.zh: 你为自己怀有一丝希望而感到生气。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I'm angry for my own self.
sentences.zh: 我在生我自己的气。

sentences.en: And I was thinking that nothing was like a miracle.
sentences.zh: 我当时还以为奇迹真的会发生。

sentences.en: I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我错了。

sentences.en: Now it hurts.
sentences.zh: 现在这让我感到痛苦。

sentences.en: I'm just thinking that I wish God would give my life to a person who could use it in a better way.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，我希望上帝能把我的生命给一个能把它用得更好的人。

sentences.en: Because I can't use it.
sentences.zh: 因为我无法好好使用它。

sentences.en: It's just a stupid thing.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一件蠢事。

sentences.en: I don't, I don't, I don't, I can't use my life.
sentences.zh: 我不会，我不会，我不能，我无法掌控我的人生。

sentences.en: The aid worker helping N is trying to think about other options for her.
sentences.zh: 协助N的救援人员正试图为她寻找其他出路。

sentences.en: As the law stands right now, there aren't a ton of legal channels that fit a case like N's.
sentences.zh: 就目前的法律而言，符合N这种状况的合法渠道并不多。

sentences.en: She's not a U.S.
sentences.zh: 她不是美国

sentences.en: citizen or a permanent resident, and she didn't work for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 公民或永久居民，她也没有为美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府工作。

sentences.en: So the aid worker thinks her next best chance to get evacuated to the states is by applying for a kind of emergency approval known as humanitarian parole.
sentences.zh: 因此救援人员认为，她去往美国的下一个最佳机会是申请一种被称为人道主义假释的紧急批准。

sentences.en: But under government protocol, N would need a sponsor and have to be vetted and screened in person at an American embassy before getting approved.
sentences.zh: 但根据政府规定，N需要有一个担保人，并且在获得批准前，必须在美国大使馆接受当面审查和筛查。

sentences.en: And right now, N would have to go to another country just to finish her application, a prospect that doesn't seem very realistic right now.
sentences.zh: 而现在，N必须去另一个国家才能完成她的申请，这个前景目前看来很不现实。

sentences.en: N says movement is hard these days.
sentences.zh: N说如今出行很艰难。

sentences.en: Just the other day, N was stopped at a Taliban checkpoint and questioned.
sentences.zh: 就在前几天，N在塔利班的一个检查站被拦下并盘问。

sentences.en: So for now, N is still in limbo.
sentences.zh: 所以目前，N仍然处于悬而未决的境地。

sentences.en: Back to a state of waiting.
sentences.zh: 回到了漫长的等待状态。

sentences.en: Life is just playing games with us.
sentences.zh: 生活只是在拿我们开玩笑。

sentences.en: You feel like you're in a game?
sentences.zh: 你觉得自己身处一场游戏中吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, instead of the game.
sentences.zh: 是的，身处这场游戏之中。

sentences.en: On the thing that life's playing with me.
sentences.zh: 生活正在戏弄我。

sentences.en: It's just like a jail.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一座监狱。

sentences.en: Like a cage.
sentences.zh: 就像一个笼子。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 接下来是你度过另一天所需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: If I can't go home and explain it to the people of West Virginia, I can't vote for it.
sentences.zh: 如果我不能回家向西弗吉尼亚州的人民解释清楚，我就无法投赞成票。

sentences.en: And I cannot vote to continue with this piece of legislation.
sentences.zh: 我也无法投票支持继续推进这项立法。

sentences.en: I just can't.
sentences.zh: 我真的做不到。

sentences.en: I've tried everything humanly possible.
sentences.zh: 我尝试了人类能力所及的一切方法。

sentences.en: I can't get there.
sentences.zh: 我无法接受它。

sentences.en: On Sunday, during an interview with Fox News, Democratic Senator Joe Manchin of West Virginia said he could not vote for the president's sweeping climate and social spending bill.
sentences.zh: 周日，西弗吉尼亚州民主党参议员乔·曼钦在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，他无法投票支持总统庞大的气候和社会支出法案。

sentences.en: Build back better in its current form, calling it too big and too expensive.
sentences.zh: 即其当前版本的《重建更好未来》法案，并称其规模过大、成本过高。

sentences.en: You're done.
sentences.zh: 你不用再说了。

sentences.en: This is a no.
sentences.zh: 这是反对票。

sentences.en: This is a no on this legislation.
sentences.zh: 这是对这项立法的反对票。

sentences.en: I have tried everything I know to do.
sentences.zh: 我已经尝试了我所知道的一切方法。

sentences.en: That decision would doom the nearly $2 trillion legislation, since Manchin's vote is required to pass it in a closely divided Senate.
sentences.zh: 这一决定将给这笔近2万亿美元的立法判处死刑，因为在势均力敌的参议院中，必须获得曼钦的赞成票才能通过。

sentences.en: But it was unclear whether Manchin, whose concerns have held up the bill for weeks, could vote for a more scaled-down version of the bill.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不清楚，其关切已经导致该法案搁置数周的曼钦，是否会投票支持该法案的一个精简版本。

sentences.en: Manchin's remarks appeared to blindside the White House, which has been deep in negotiations with him.
sentences.zh: 曼钦的言论似乎让白宫感到措手不及，白宫此前一直与他进行深入谈判。

sentences.en: In a sharply worded response, White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki accused Manchin of breaking his promises to both Biden and congressional Democrats,
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书珍·普萨基在措辞严厉的回应中指责曼钦违背了对拜登和国会民主党人的承诺，

sentences.en: but said that the president would still seek to win Manchin over.
sentences.zh: 但表示总统仍将争取赢得曼钦的支持。

sentences.en: And over the weekend, New York State set a new daily record for COVID infections, reporting nearly 22,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 上周末，纽约州创下了新冠感染人数的新日高纪录，报告了近2.2万起病例。

sentences.en: Epidemiologists said it appeared that the highly contagious Omicron variant was moving quickly throughout the state,
sentences.zh: 流行病学家表示，极具传染性的奥密克戎变异株似乎正在全州迅速蔓延，

sentences.en: just as an earlier variant of the virus did back in March of 2020.
sentences.zh: 正如该病毒的早期变异株在2020年3月所做的那样。

sentences.en: We expect Omicron to be a fast and temporary phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 我们预计奥密克戎将是一个快速且暂时的现象。

sentences.en: We expect these next weeks to see a very, very big surge in the number of cases, more than we've seen previously.
sentences.zh: 我们预计接下来的几周，病例数量将会出现非常非常大的激增，超过我们以往所见。

sentences.en: During a briefing on Sunday, the mayor of New York City, Bill de Blasio, predicted a short-lived surge in infections.
sentences.zh: 纽约市长埃里克·亚当斯在周日的简报会上预测，感染人数将出现短期的激增。

sentences.en: And then we expect, after a period of time, that it will dissipate.
sentences.zh: 然后我们预计，经过一段时间后，它就会消散。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Lindsay Garrison, with help from Daniel Guimet.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由琳赛·加里森制作，丹尼尔·吉梅特协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Anita Bonagio and Larissa Anderson, contains original music from Marion Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由安妮塔·博纳吉奥和拉里萨·安德森剪辑，原创音乐由马里昂·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔创作，工程制作由克里斯·伍德负责。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由吉姆·布伦伯格和温德利的本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Alyssa Rubin, Laura Jakes, Michael Benoit, MJ Davis-Lynn, Rojean Jacket, David McCraw, and Douglas Shorsman.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢艾莉莎·鲁宾、劳拉·杰克斯、迈克尔·布努瓦、MJ·戴维斯-林恩、罗让·杰克、大卫·麦克劳和道格拉斯·肖尔斯曼。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏迷过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require, because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有食物过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《电线切割机秀》。
